actions.name: Use
actions.area: all dead creatures within a 30-ft.-burst, centered on caster.

duration.value: 1 round/level DESCRIPTION You know how to gain strength from fallen allies and enemies alike. You gain a +1 profane bonus to attack rolls, saving throws, and damage rolls for every dead creature in a 30 feet radius up to a maximum of +3.
